title: feat(nmpfail): forall-orthogonal M vs O at t+1 on #7188: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same #7188 x-probe cell, forall-orthogonal readout: forall-perp HOLDs at all four probes while axis-cover FAILs at three of them - the sharpest predicate separation in the band. It also carries the nstri counterexample where exist-perp HOLDs at B and forall-perp FAILs (+e_1 sits in both M(B) and O(B), dot=1), establishing the three-way independence forall-perp / exist-perp / cover.
